anchors.1: Explicit categorical refusal of this specified aspect despite any restriction, consent, mitigation, benefit or other modification. This takes precedence over score 2; removing the rejected aspect does not make that aspect acceptable. Do not infer from route rejection alone.
anchors.2: Strong personal intrusion/risk boundary requiring removal or avoidance of the effect; needs evidence beyond strong disruption to daily life. Conditional openness does not erase the boundary.
anchors.3: Strong concrete disruption to rest or daily life requiring substantial mitigation, removal or avoidance; strong acoustic disturbance alone fits here rather than automatically constituting a personal intrusion boundary. Serious loss of after-work quiet or evening relaxation qualifies; sleep loss is not required. Willingness after inaudibility or rerouting does not reduce disruption to a generic condition.
anchors.4: Meaningful prerequisite change without explicit categorical refusal, a personal intrusion/risk boundary, or strong concrete disruption to rest or daily life. Classify the expressed impact, not the remedy alone.
anchors.5: Balanced concern-specific willingness and reservations; uncertainty without a position stays null.
anchors.6: Accepts this specified aspect with explicitly expressed caution or limited reservations. Plain acceptance without a stated reservation is 8; other-aspect objections do not supply caution. Already stipulated proposal conditions are not further requirements.
anchors.7: Accepts this specified aspect with manageable remaining requirements or reservations; preserve those requirements.
anchors.8: Clear acceptance or support of this specified aspect without an expressed reservation, including a brief statement that it is acceptable. Lack of enthusiasm is not caution; other concern opposition is separate. Unqualified endorsement uses 9.
anchors.9: Explicit citizen-authored unqualified endorsement, no remaining requirements; independently checked. Bare Yes/choices/confirmation do not suffice.

index_interpretation: Illustrative arithmetic index over ordinal concern scores; not a calibrated measurement.
bottleneck_rationale: Cap the assessed-concern mean at the minimum assessed concern score plus 2, irrespective of phase and without a severity threshold.
